# `stevethemes`: Steve’s `ggplot2` Themes and Related Theme Elements

[![](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/stevethemes?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevethemes)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/stevethemes?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevethemes)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-month/stevethemes?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevethemes)
[![](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/last-week/stevethemes?color=green)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=stevethemes)

![stevethemes
hexlogo](http://svmiller.com/images/stevethemes-hexlogo.png)

`stevethemes` is an R package including various
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org) themes and theme elements that
I find useful and aesthetically pleasing. It also includes some various
helper functions for adjusting plots to taste for either the web or a
printed manuscript. Its use heavily implies, but does not formally
require, free fonts you can download from Google. In particular, it
suggests use of Titillium Web, Open Sans, Fira Sans, and Crimson Pro.
The package has simple forms of these fonts available for you to install
on your computer, though you can easily download these fonts (and more)
from Google as well.

## Installation

You can install this on CRAN.

``` r

install.packages("stevethemes")
```

The development version may also have some extra goodies not yet
published on CRAN. You can install the development version of
`stevethemes` from Github via the `devtools` package. I suppose using
the `remotes` package would work as well.

``` r

devtools::install_github("svmiller/stevethemes")
```

# Package index

## Functions

Functions included in this data set.

- [`are_fonts_installed()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/are_fonts_installed.md)
  : Check if you have the fonts you need already installed on your
  computer

- [`example_plot()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/example_plot.md) :

  Create an example plot (in ggplot2) for experimenting with different
  styles

- [`adj_font_size()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/fine-tune.md) :

  Miscellaneous functions for fine-tuning ggplot2 plots

- [`g_c()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/g_c.md) :

  Get a Custom Color from `steve_hex`

- [`how_to_install_fonts()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/how_to_install_fonts.md)
  : Learn how to install fonts on your computer

- [`lighten_hex()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/lighten_hex.md) :
  Whiten an RGB Hex Value

- [`no_gridlines()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/print-ready.md)
  [`make_classic()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/print-ready.md) :

  Miscellaneous functions to make your ggplot2 plot "print-ready"

- [`spal()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/spal.md) :

  Load a palette in `scale_*_manual()`

- [`swatchplot()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/swatchplot.md) :
  Create a Swatchplot of Palettes

- [`theme_steve()`](https://svmiller.com/reference/theme_steve.md) :

  Steve's Preferred ggplot2 Theme

## Datasets

Example data sets available to use for illustration purposes.

- [`brandy`](https://svmiller.com/reference/brandy.md) : Brandy,
  1942-2017
- [`britneywork`](https://svmiller.com/reference/britneywork.md) : The
  Civilian Unemployment Rate, 2013-2018
- [`cowwaryears`](https://svmiller.com/reference/cowwaryears.md) :
  Correlates of War War Counts, by Year (1816-2007)
- [`imfquotas`](https://svmiller.com/reference/imfquotas.md) : IMF
  Quotas, Special Drawing Rights
- [`kwh_gdp`](https://svmiller.com/reference/kwh_gdp.md) : Kilowatt
  Hours per Capita and GDP per Capita, 2010
- [`martel_ratings`](https://svmiller.com/reference/martel_ratings.md) :
  CAGEMATCH Ratings of Rick Martel
- [`oilrents`](https://svmiller.com/reference/oilrents.md) : Oil Rents
  and GDP per Capita, Over Time
- [`palettes`](https://svmiller.com/reference/palettes.md) : Palettes
  Available in This Package
- [`se_counties_gdppc`](https://svmiller.com/reference/se_counties_gdppc.md)
  : GDP per Capita of Swedish Counties, 2001-2020
- [`steve_hex`](https://svmiller.com/reference/steve_hex.md) : Some Hex
  Triplets I Find Useful/Interesting/Fun
- [`uspopgengroup`](https://svmiller.com/reference/uspopgengroup.md) :
  U.S. Population Size, by Birth Cohort (Generation) and Race/Ethnic
  Category
